'''Urce Space''', or the '''Urce sector''', was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] within the [[Lesser Plooriod Cluster/Legends|Lesser Plooriod Cluster]]. It was located between the [[Burna Trade Route]] and the [[Entana Run]].<ref name="AIR" />

==History==
[[High Inquisitor]] [[Mox Slosin]] was transferred to Urce after the [[Subjugation of Fitca|subjugation]] of the [[Fitca system]].<ref name="AIR" />
